description: This header file provides helper functions for extracting and setting various data types (string, int, double, bool) from and to cJSON JSON objects. It defines function prototypes for retrieving string, integer, double, and boolean values based on keys within JSON objects, as well as a function to set boolean values. It also includes a convenience inline function to delete cJSON objects safely. The file is part of a JSON helper utility in a larger codebase.

methods.name: getCJSONString
methods.description: Extracts the string value for a given key from a JSON object. Caller must free the returned string.

methods.name: getCJSONInt
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value for a specified key from a JSON object, returning true if successful.

methods.name: getCJSONDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a double value for a specified key from a JSON object, returning true if successful.

methods.name: getCJSONBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value for a specified key from a JSON object, returning true if successful.

methods.name: setCJSONBool
methods.description: Sets the value of a boolean in a JSON object.
